title: Absolutely useless
text:
Absolutely useless. This product is complete garbage. I ended up literally tossing it in the trash.
I followed the directions exactly. I got hard eggs. I realized one segment of the directions online said to add water before the egg. I did that. Hard eggs. Then I added both but waters (too and bottom) and hard eggs. Then I simply cut back the time at 50% power (instructions that come with it said to use 50% power). That produced one hard egg and one semi-poached but mostly uncooked egg. I tried cutting the time back at 100% power. Hard eggs again. The instructions were wrong (and I have a great microwave) or just flung together. I really wanted this to work but it’s pointless. Like I said, I threw it away I was soooo frustrated. Yes I could have returned it but I was soooo frustrated and disappointed that I simply done with it. I used a big box of eggs to try every conceivable possible way to cook them. It simply doesn’t poach or one doesn’t cook at all.
Save your money. This is useless.
I’m soooooooo disappointed.

product_metadata.title: 2 Cavity Egg Poacher - Microwave In One Minute - BPA Free - For Quick & Healthy Breakfast
description: Do you love poached eggs? Think that poaching eggs is too complicated? Do you crave eggs but avoid cooking them because you don’t feel like watching them on the stove and washing the pots and pans? Here’s the solution for a lazy cook: cooking eggs in a microwave! You must be thinking now: how do I cook eggs in a microwave? Read on and you’ll see step-by-step instructions with pictures on how to cook eggs in a microwave. Cooking eggs in a microwave is really easy when you use a special gadget: microwave egg poacher. Place 1/2 tsp water in each cup, just crack the egg in poacher, puncture a bit the yolk, snap lid closed, put it in the microwave and 1 minute later you have yummy poached eggs! No cleanup needed – once you are done eating your microwave-cooked eggs, just put the microwave egg poacher in a dishwasher – microwave egg poacher is dishwasher-safe upper shelf. Please follow the instructions carefully.
